item.tib: zhi ba g.yung drung yongs su rdzogs pa'i mngon rtogs
item.coloph: de ltar zhi ba g.yung drung yongs rdzogs kyi mngon rtogs 'di/ gzhung gi dgongs pa dang gong ma'i gsung sgros la gzhi bslang nas/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan bdag gis sbyar ba la/ 'gal 'khrul ci mchis yul mchog dam pa dang*/ stang 'dzin dam can rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun kun bzang sa thob shog bkra shis dar la rgyas par shog/
